title: 建築デザイン論
subtitle: Method of Architectural Design
keywords: Architectural design 2.Spatial production 3.Architectural philosophy and historical background 4.The trend of architectural design 5.Regional characteristics and architecture
educationalGoal: Higher class of Introduction to Architecture. Learns from architectural ideas that capture culturally and artistically the buildings that are the vessels of human activity. Analyze and consider various architectural designs and to think about what is excellent architecture based on the background of the times. In addition, the goal is to learn about the design methods to apply and develop the knowledge to the creation of works for architectural exercises A and B and Project Design Ⅲ.
advice: A-1 Architectural prototype B-8 Reading architectural design A-2 1 Monsoon Architecture B-9 The origin of the image and the narrative A-3 2 Desert Architecture B-10 Evaluation of architectural design A-4 11 modern houses B-11 World Square and gardens A-5 Programs and architecture B-12 Spatial production of approach A-6 Architects Toyo Ito B-13 landscape design A-7 Architectural practices B-14 Architect's work and case studies B-15 Inner / outer boundary and environmental device A:Takeuchi B:Hachiya
requiredKnowledge: Completed the first semester of Introduction to Architecture and the third and fourth semester of Architectural Design Studio I and II, no need any special background knowledge or skills.

activityGoals.body: Understand the roles and characteristics of the Architecture including the historical background.
Analyze and evaluate architecture and urban space and use these results to create new architectural spaces.
Understand the relationship between historical background and architectural design philosophy.
Understand the trends and cutting-edge trends in contemporary architectural design and apply them to own design.

achievementLevels.ideal: Analyze and explain the conditions such as function, composition, beauty, etc. according to the use required of the architectural space, and the characteristics and role of the building (group) that forms the area including the climate and the historical background. Recognized how important the design philosophy and ideas were, and applied these to own works. Discuss the design philosophy and the uniqueness of the design, and gain the understanding of third parties.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the conditions such as function, composition, beauty, etc. according to the use required of the architectural space, and the features and roles of the architecture (group) that forms the area including the climate and historical background. Recognizing how important the design philosophy and ideas are, and applying them to architectural design courses.

lessons.content: Architectural prototype ・ Learn the meaning of architecture and the meaning of designing. ・ ReportⅠQuestion
lessons.assignments: Review the syllabus Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the terms learned in class.

lessons.content: Regional characteristics and Architecture ・Monsoon Architecture Architectures in monsoon climate mainly in Asia. Learn about the relationship between climate and architecture through villages.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the terms learned in class.

lessons.content: Regional characteristics and Architecture ・Desert Architecture Architectures in desert climates centered on Africa and the Middle East. Learn about the relationship between climate and architecture through villages.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the terms learned in class.

lessons.content: 11 modern houses ・Learn the architect's philosophy and background behind the work through the masterpiece of the house from the postwar period to the present day.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate other cases.

lessons.content: Programs and architecture Learn modern thinking about the relationship between architecture and program through thoughts and discussions that took place in the 1990s and early 2000s.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the terms learned in class.

lessons.content: Architects Toyo Ito Learn about the creativity of architecture through the changes in the works and ideas of world-renowned architects from the beginning to the present.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the terms learned in class.

lessons.content: Architectural practices Introduce the various acts and thoughts performed in the design through the teacher's own project. ・ Introduce how to train your ability to think about architecture and design. ・ Return and comment on Report I
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the books introduced in class.

lessons.content: Keywords for decrypting architectural design ・ Learn about the important terms for deciphering architectural design, and the relationship between the meaning of words and the actual work. ・ Report Ⅱ questions
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the works of architects, in architect monograph.

lessons.content: The origin of the image and the narrative. ・ Learn about the source of images that create architectural forms and spaces, and the narrative of architecture that tells viewers something.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate other cases on their own and apply them to own design.

lessons.content: Evaluation of architectural design ・Evaluate architecture based on historical backgrounds, regional characteristics, and trends in the architectural world, and consider what we should design now.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate the architectural features learned in class.

lessons.content: World Square and famous gardens ・ Learn about the overall exterior space of an architectural scale, and learn how to design architecture that integrates inside and outside. ・ Submission of report
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes. Investigate other cases on their own and apply them to own design.

lessons.content: Spatial production of approach ・Learn how to produce a space that switches consciousness and places. Free discussion on architecturaldesign Disclosing the tendency of exam questions
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes.

lessons.content: Landscape design ・ Learn the concept and examples of landscape design. ・Tests and their answers
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of the lesson with lecture notes.

lessons.content: Architect's work and case studies ・ Learn the whole perspective of the work performed by architects. Free discussion on architectural design.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of theless on with lecture notes. Review the content of the open discussion.

lessons.content: Intermediate area inside and outside and environmental adjustment device ・ Learn about architecture that uses environmental control equipment in architectural designs. ・Report review Conduct survey of class questionnaire.
lessons.assignments: Review the contents of theless on with lecture notes.
